# nft list table inet f2b-table
table inet f2b-table {
	set addr-set-sshd {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 198.51.100.23, 203.0.113.5 }
	}

	set addr-set-recidive {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 192.0.2.77 }
	}

	chain f2b-chain {
		type filter hook input priority filter - 1; policy accept;
		tcp dport { 22, 2222 } ip saddr @addr-set-sshd reject with icmp port-unreachable
		meta l4proto tcp ip saddr @addr-set-recidive reject with icmp port-unreachable
	}
}
